listing.name: Doom II (Crispy Doom family)
listing.summary: Install the official Crispy Doom Windows runtime. Play opens upstream setup and launch controls; supply your own matching original game files.

steps.title: Supply the matching original game files
steps.instruction: Supply DOOM2.WAD from your original PC Doom II copy; the separate French edition uses DOOM2F.WAD. Doom shareware does not provide Doom II. Keep your originals and edition identity; renaming another game’s WAD does not convert it. Originals are not included or authenticated by Portcove. Use a recognized upstream installation, or deliberately copy matching files into the originals subfolder (named exactly originals) of this entry’s fresh private data folder; keep your original copies.

steps.title: Use the upstream setup and launch controls
steps.instruction: Play opens crispy-doom-setup.exe. Configure controls and use F2 Warp for single-player launch; choose the matching detected IWAD there. The main-menu launch command forwards its existing arguments. The PWAD/mod browser is not an original-IWAD browser. Keep different title entries separate. Do not switch this entry’s original edition in place: its retained runtime versions share data. Use a separate Portcove library or independently owned upstream copy for another source variant. No automatic switching or cross-variant save compatibility is established. An upstream setup exit does not establish that the game loaded or ran successfully.

steps.title: Keep the declared private data scope
steps.instruction: Portcove retains originals deliberately copied under originals, this entry’s default configuration, saves under saves, known default save locations, numbered screenshots and declared recording files. Put custom recordings under demos or use a demo-prefixed .lmp filename. Upstream may read and write its music-pack profile on Play. Music packs and custom paths outside this installation remain external and outside Portcove backups. Extra files written inside the installation outside its declared folders are outside this offered scope and can block maintenance. Keep the creating runtime, original files and actual data before changing a source variant or using an older runtime.

steps.title: Keep updates in one place
steps.instruction: Portcove manages this new official game installation and the data listed for it. It does not import an existing project profile or convert a separately registered game. Existing registered copies keep their external files and update tools. Back up those external profiles and original files separately. Automated fixture checks and reaching a setup menu do not establish original-file or gameplay compatibility.

warnings: Play opens the project’s setup and launch controls. Supply your own matching original game files that you are permitted to use.
Portcove backups exclude external music packs, custom paths and data belonging to separately registered games.

references.title: Install the native package on Linux or Mac
references.instruction: On Debian, install the crispy-doom package through the package manager. On Mac, use the upstream-documented MacPorts port or a supported Homebrew formula. Start crispy-doom with -iwad followed by the quoted path to your own DOOM2.WAD from Doom II or DOOM2F.WAD from the French edition. Use the external package manager for replacement.

references.title: Keep the existing Crispy profile
references.instruction: Preserve the actual Crispy config, saves, demos and original IWADs. Linux normally uses ~/.local/share/crispy-doom or XDG_DATA_HOME/crispy-doom. Mac normally uses ~/Library/Application Support/crispy-doom. Keep any custom locations and the creating runtime before switching package versions. The external profile can be shared across games.
